records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Mileage Plan other revenue increased $37 million, or 13%, in the first six months of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Passenger revenue for the second quarter of 2023 increased by $180 million, or 7%, on a 9% increase in passenger traffic, partially offset by a slight decrease in yield.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Fuel gallons consumed increased 6%, consistent with rising capacity.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Fuel costs moderated in the second quarter, with economic price per gallon decreasing 27% as compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the first six months of 2023, net cash provided by operating activities was $832 million, compared to $1.2 billion during the same period in 2022.
